description_en: A flat plate with 4 corner mounting holes
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
width = 120        # 宽度 (mm)
depth = 80         # 深度 (mm)
thickness = 5      # 厚度 (mm)
hole_diameter = 5  # 安装孔直径 (mm)
edge_distance = 10 # 孔距边缘 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(width, depth, thickness)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .rect(width - 2 * edge_distance, depth - 2 * edge_distance, forConstruction=True)
    .vertices()
    .hole(hole_diameter)
)

show_object(result)
